source: PlantDoc official test split (236 images), MobileNetV3Large fine-tuned on PlantDoc field photographs, 2026-09-28. blur_note: Laplacian-variance blur detection was evaluated as a way to tell a blurry photo apart from an out-of-taxonomy plant, and rejected on evidence: the correlation between log10(Laplacian variance) and model confidence is -0.013, and median sharpness is near-identical across all three confidence bands. Of the 31 test images below 0.50 confidence, 28 are sharp (Laplacian variance >= 100) and only 3 are blurry. The app therefore ships no blur detector; the fix was wording and tiering.
